title: Node.js Memory Leak in WebSocket Gateway
description: The WebSocket gateway service is consuming memory linearly. Garbage collection is unable to reclaim memory, leading to an eventual OOM crash every 6 hours.
error_log: FATAL ERROR: Reached heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory
actual_behavior: Service crashes due to memory leak
recent_changes: Added tracking for connected clients using a Map without proper cleanup
